{"id":2019895377,"question_id":3965,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 3 weeks","timestamp":1780384493,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2019895377/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Earliest Finish Time for Land and Water Rides I","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ti = tuple<int,int,int>;\n\n    int earliestFinishTime(vector<int>& landStartTime, vector<int>& landDuration, vector<int>& waterStartTime, vector<int>& waterDuration) {\n        int n = landStartTime.size();\n        int m = waterStartTime.size();\n\n        vector<ti>events;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++) events.push_back({landStartTime[i] , landDuration[i] , 1});\n        \n        for(int i = 0 ; i<m ; i++) events.push_back({waterStartTime[i] , waterDuration[i] , 0});\n\n        sort(begin(events) , end(events));\n\n        bool landdone = false , waterdone = false;\n        int time = 0;\n\n        for(auto it : events)\n        {\n            int type = get<2>(it);\n            int duration = get<1>(it);\n            int st = get<0>(it);\n\n            if(landdone and waterdone) break;\n\n            if(!landdone and !waterdone)\n            {\n                time += st;\n                time += duration;\n                if(type == 1) landdone = true;\n                else waterdone = true;\n            }\n            else if(!landdone)\n            {\n                time += duration;\n                landdone = true;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                time += duration;\n                waterdone = true;\n            }\n        }\n        return time;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"earliest-finish-time-for-land-and-water-rides-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2050}
